title: LLM
description: GPU, model switcher queue, vLLM and LiteLLM metrics. The model filter applies to vLLM. Latency metrics appear after requests; missing latency data is not replaced with zero.

panels.description: Telemetry collection status, not inference availability. GPU samples must be less than 60 seconds old.

panels.title: Model switcher · Queue and active model
Running and waiting requests
panels.description: The llm-switcher queue upstream of vLLM. Running requests include model startup, so this count differs from the number of requests generating tokens in vLLM.

panels.title: Last confirmed loaded model
panels.description: 1 identifies the last model confirmed as loaded by the switcher. This does not check vLLM readiness.

panels.title: GPU temperature
panels.description: Only successful GPU collection samples less than 60 seconds old are shown. Missing sensor data is not replaced with zero.

panels.title: GPU and memory controller utilization
panels.description: Only successful GPU collection samples less than 60 seconds old are shown. Missing sensor data is not replaced with zero.

panels.title: GPU memory · Used and total
panels.description: Only successful GPU collection samples less than 60 seconds old are shown. Missing sensor data is not replaced with zero.

panels.title: GPU memory utilization
panels.description: Only successful GPU collection samples less than 60 seconds old are shown. Missing sensor data is not replaced with zero.

targets.expr: (socrat_gpu_memory_used_bytes / socrat_gpu_memory_total_bytes and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1)) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60)

panels.title: Power draw and limit
panels.description: Only successful GPU collection samples less than 60 seconds old are shown. Missing sensor data is not replaced with zero.

panels.title: Fan speed
panels.description: Only successful GPU collection samples less than 60 seconds old are shown. Missing sensor data is not replaced with zero.

panels.title: GPU and memory clock speeds
panels.description: Only successful GPU collection samples less than 60 seconds old are shown. Missing sensor data is not replaced with zero.

panels.title: GPU performance state
panels.description: P0 indicates maximum performance; higher values indicate more power-efficient states. Only successful GPU collection samples less than 60 seconds old are shown. Missing sensor data is not replaced with zero.

panels.title: Clock throttling reasons
panels.description: 1 means the reason is active. Idle may be a normal state when the GPU has no work. Only successful GPU collection samples less than 60 seconds old are shown. Missing sensor data is not replaced with zero.

panels.title: GPU collection age
panels.description: Time since the last collection. Other GPU charts hide data when collection fails or data is older than 60 seconds.

panels.title: vLLM · Requests, tokens and KV cache
vLLM requests · Running and waiting
panels.description: The internal vLLM queue, separate from the model switcher queue.

panels.title: KV cache utilization
panels.description: vLLM KV cache utilization. This is separate from total GPU memory utilization.

panels.title: Token throughput
panels.description: Tokens per second averaged over the rate interval.

panels.title: Request completions by reason
panels.description: The request_success_total metric also includes abort and error outcomes; each completion reason is shown separately.

panels.title: Prefix cache hit ratio
panels.description: Proportion of reused tokens. The ratio is undefined without cache queries.

panels.title: KV cache request preemptions
panels.description: Preemptions per second due to insufficient KV cache capacity.

panels.title: Time to first token
panels.description: Percentiles over the rate interval. Latency is undefined when there are no requests in the interval.

panels.title: End-to-end request latency
panels.description: Percentiles over the rate interval. Latency is undefined when there are no requests in the interval.

panels.title: Inter-token latency
panels.description: Percentiles over the rate interval. Latency is undefined when there are no requests in the interval.

panels.title: vLLM queue wait
panels.description: Percentiles over the rate interval. Latency is undefined when there are no requests in the interval.

panels.title: Input processing
panels.description: Percentiles over the rate interval. Latency is undefined when there are no requests in the interval.

panels.title: Response generation
panels.description: Percentiles over the rate interval. Latency is undefined when there are no requests in the interval.

panels.title: LiteLLM requests over selected range
panels.description: Counter increase over the selected range. History starts when collection was enabled; Prometheus estimates the increase from scrape samples.

panels.title: LiteLLM errors over selected range
panels.description: Counter increase over the selected range. History starts when collection was enabled; Prometheus estimates the increase from scrape samples.

panels.title: LiteLLM requests
panels.description: Requests per second reported by LiteLLM callbacks.

panels.title: LiteLLM errors
panels.description: Request errors reported by LiteLLM callbacks; a series appears after the corresponding event.

panels.title: LiteLLM error ratio
panels.description: The ratio is undefined without requests. Missing error series are treated as zero only for models with a known request series and a positive request rate.

targets.expr: (sum by(requested_model) (rate(litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric_total{job="litellm"}[$__rate_interval])) or on(requested_model) (0 * sum by(requested_model) (rate(litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric_total{job="litellm"}[$__rate_interval])))) / (sum by(requested_model) (rate(litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric_total{job="litellm"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: LiteLLM token throughput
panels.description: Tokens per second reported by LiteLLM callbacks.

panels.title: LiteLLM total latency
panels.description: Percentiles over the rate interval. No data is available without requests.

panels.title: Model API latency
panels.description: Percentiles over the rate interval. No data is available without requests.

panels.title: LiteLLM time to first token
panels.description: Percentiles over the rate interval. No data is available without requests.

panels.title: Time before model invocation
panels.description: Percentiles over the rate interval. No data is available without requests. Includes authentication and ASGI processing before model invocation; this measures elapsed time, not the number of queued requests.

panels.title: Container CPU
panels.description: Logical CPU cores in use.

panels.title: Container memory
panels.description: Working set RAM, separate from GPU memory.

panels.title: Restarts per hour
panels.description: Container restarts over a rolling one-hour window.

panels.title: Container readiness
panels.description: 1 means the container readiness check passed.
